products.notes: kicker.com product page (part no. 51KST2004). 3/4 in silk dome. Supplied crossover: 12 dB/oct high-pass at 4.5 kHz. Recommended amplifier power 10-65 W RMS. Peak power per ANSI/CTA-2031-A. Flush-mount depth/hole given. No T/S published.

kicker.com product page (part no. 51KST2504). 1 in silk dome. Supplied crossover: 12 dB/oct high-pass at 3.5 kHz. Recommended amplifier power 10-75 W RMS. Peak power per ANSI/CTA-2031-A. Flush-mount depth/hole given. No T/S published. Same 1 in KST tweeter is used in the KSS component sets.

kicker.com product page (2019 CS tweeter, CST20). 3/4 in titanium dome. Supplied crossover: 6 dB/oct high-pass at 4.5 kHz. Recommended amplifier power 50 W RMS. Peak power per ANSI/CTA-2031-A. No T/S published.

kicker.com product page (part no. 49ST3TW). 1 in aluminum bullet tweeter (pro-audio style, very high sensitivity). Supplied in-line 6 dB/oct high-pass capacitor (value not stated). Recommended amplifier power 15-50 W RMS. Mounting diameter 58 mm; thread length 27 mm, thread diameter 43 mm. No T/S published.

kicker.com product page (part no. 49ST4TW). 1.5 in aluminum bullet tweeter (pro-audio style, very high sensitivity). Supplied in-line 6 dB/oct high-pass capacitor (value not stated). Recommended amplifier power 15-50 W RMS. Mounting diameter 73 mm; thread length 30 mm, thread diameter 48 mm. No T/S published.
